C.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed
Do not tag when a fraction is merely simplified rather than rewritten to a common denominator

skills.name: Normalize fractional form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a more workable equivalent form, such as simplifying a fraction part, converting an improper mixed-number part to a standard mixed number, or expressing a whole number with a zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number
Tag when a fraction part is simplified before subtraction
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole number plus 0 over a chosen denominator
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag routine combination of final whole and fractional parts
Do not tag common-denominator conversion of unlike fractions; that belongs to finding a common denominator
Do not tag final reduction of an answer to lowest terms

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator directly
Tag when the fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators have been matched
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag whole-number subtraction by itself
Do not tag the borrowing step used to create a larger fractional part
Do not tag conversion to equivalent fractions before subtraction

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the quantities when working with mixed numbers or whole numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 2
Tag when a whole-number minuend or subtrahend is treated as the whole part in a mixed-number subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of numerators in a fraction-only problem unless whole parts are explicitly involved
Do not tag the later recombination of whole and fractional results

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is taken from the whole part and converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units
Tag when borrowing is used after an initial negative fractional difference or anticipated fractional shortfall
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed
Do not tag normalization steps that only rewrite forms without taking 1 from the whole part

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Express the subtraction result in lowest terms and in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms
Tag when 0 over a denominator is rewritten as 0 or when a zero fractional part is absorbed into a whole number
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed number or fraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps before the result form is finalized
Do not tag rewriting done solely to prepare for subtraction

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts
Tag when fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same
Do not tag when a fraction is only simplified or normalized without creating a common denominator

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, mixed number, or non-simplified fractional part into a subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number
Tag when a fractional part is simplified before subtraction to match the other operand structure
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for equivalent-fraction conversion used to create a common denominator
Do not tag for final simplification of the answer after subtraction
Do not tag when no rewriting of an operand occurs

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the operands are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted
Tag when a solution separately subtracts whole parts and fraction parts
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding the common denominator itself
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping after a negative fractional difference appears
Do not tag for combining or formatting the final result

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole-number part and converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units
Tag when the solution first gets a negative fractional difference and then regroups to continue subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus zero fraction before any borrowing occurs
Do not tag for simple combination of already computed whole and fractional results

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or recognize that a zero fraction equals 0 or a whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 9/12 to 3/4
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0
Tag when the solution explicitly states a simplified whole-number result after fractional cancellation
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for simplifying an operand before subtraction
Do not tag when the result is already in lowest terms and no simplification step is shown
Do not tag for merely writing the final answer in mixed-number form without reduction

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine computed whole and fractional parts into the final integer, fraction, or mixed-number answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole-part and fraction-part results are recombined into one answer
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction
Tag when the solution explicitly states the final mixed number or integer after prior computations
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction computations themselves
Do not tag for simplification alone unless the step also recombines parts into final form
Do not tag when no recombination or final formatting step is shown
